subject: MAP kickoff: stakeholder roster, calendar holds, and eval prioritization
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna.park@acmehealth.com>; Acme Health Evaluation Team <evals@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: stakeholder roster, calendar holds, and eval prioritization

Hi Jenna & team,

Thanks for the productive discovery last week — looking forward to kicking off the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align on success criteria and a tight close timeline. To get us started Ive put together a short agenda and a draft MAP template (attached). Key asks for this kickoff:

- Confirm primary stakeholders for technical, security, and procurement tracks (weve listed suggested names below)
- Lock a 60 minute kickoff slot next week so we can run the MAP walkthrough and prioritize the eval matrix
- Agree on three evaluation priorities (latency under 150ms, end-to-end PII redaction checks, 99.9% availability for test windows) so we can size the Dedicated pool if needed

Suggested attendees (please confirm):
- Jenna Park (Acme) — Product Lead / evaluation owner
- Alex Martinez (Acme) — SRE / infra
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — AE / MAP owner
- Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — Solutions Architect
- Ben Carter (Redwood) — Evaluation lead / bench tests
- Monica Patel (Redwood) — CSM / onboarding ops

Proposed times (PDT) next week:
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00 - 11:00
- Wed Aug 4, 13:00 - 14:00
- Thu Aug 5, 09:00 - 10:00

Ive attached the kickoff agenda (short) and the MAP template for your team to preview. If none of the times above work, tell us two windows that do and well accommodate.

Zoom & calendar: once Jenna confirms attendees/time, well send a calendar invite and Zoom link.

Thanks — happy to be flexible to fit your internal review cadence.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MAP-template.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB), kickoff-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: stakeholder roster, calendar holds, and eval prioritization

Karthik — thanks, this looks good. Quick notes from our side:

- Confirmed internal attendees: me (Product), Alex Martinez (SRE), Priya Natarajan (Security) — Im looping Priya into the evaluation thread separately for the security checklist.
- Evaluation priorities: wed like to prioritize (1) correctness on clinical extraction (F1 > 0.92), (2) latency targets for 512-token sequences (p95 < 150ms), and (3) reproducibility of anonymization across runs.
- Procurement: Ill pull in our procurement rep if we decide Dedicated capacity is required following the eval window.

For the kickoff, Wed Aug 4 13:00 - 14:00 PDT works best for our group. Please go ahead and send the calendar invite.

One ask before the call: can Redwood prepare a short test plan snapshot (1 page) that maps each eval priority to the test well run and the pass/fail criteria? That will help our internal stakeholders sign off quickly.

Thanks — Jenna

Jenna Park
